items.title: Meta's Ember is a bet on cheaper models with competitors
items.summary: Yahoo Finance's Deirdre Bosa and "In the Loop" host Ejaaz Ahamadeen discuss Meta's  (META) new Ember model, designed as a low-cost, quick option to compete with smaller models like ChatGPT's Luna and Claude's Haiku.

items.title: California Privacy Agency Fines FedEx Nearly $3M
items.summary: California has fined FedEx nearly $3 million over alleged privacy violations - including failing to honor opt-out commands sent through the Global Privacy Control.

items.title: Why the Data Center Backlash Could Fall Flat: Increased Costs “a Trade That These Hyperscalers Are Still Going to Want to Make”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysTexas governor-elect Gina Hinojosa plans to make newly permitted data centers pay taxes, avoid raising consumer power prices and use union labor. Gene Munster puts soft costs at about 15% of a data center’s bill, so a 30% jump in them raises the total only about 5%.

items.title: Nvidia in the hot seat, Anthropic to test the IPO market, hotter-than-expected US inflation
items.summary:
Host Kevin Kelly, Kelly Intelligence Founder, CEO, and CCO, and his panel of experts weigh in on the alleged plot to spy on Nvidia's Jensen Huang, why retail investors should wait for Anthropic's IPO instead of chasing private markets, and what the next moves should be for the Federal Reserve after the latest inflation print. 

Today's panel includes Drew Pettit, Roundhill Investments' Chief Investment Strategist; Robert Schein, Blanke Schein Wealth Management's chief investment officer; and Christine Short, TMX Wall Street Horizon's Head of Corporate Event Research.
